text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English says \"Tourism Strategy\" while French says \"nouvelle stratégie touristique\" (new tourism strategy).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "Tourism Strategy", "before": "adopted the Confederation’s"}, "tgt": {"quote": "nouvelle stratégie touristique", "before": "a adopté, le 10 novembre 2021, la"}, "severity": 0.4}, {"reason": "English says \"It provides the basis...\" while French says \"Ce document constitue le socle...\" (different phrasing for the same idea).", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "It provides the basis for the federal government's tourism policy and continues the strategic direction of the previous, proven strategy.", "before": "It"}, "tgt": {"quote": "Ce document constitue le socle de la politique fédérale du tourisme et s’inscrit dans la continuité de la stratégie précédente, qui a fait ses preuves.", "before": "Le"}, "severity": 0.4}, {"reason": "English file size is \"12 MB\" while French file size is \"13 MB\".", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "12 MB", "before": "Tourism Strategy of the Swiss Confederation (PDF,"}, "tgt": {"quote": "13 MB", "before": "Stratégie touristique de la Confédération (PDF,"}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "English date is \"25.10.2022\" while French date is \"01.03.2022\".", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "25.10.2022", "before": "Tourism Strategy of the Swiss Confederation (PDF,"}, "tgt": {"quote": "01.03.2022", "before": "Stratégie touristique de la Confédération (PDF,"}, "severity": 0.8}]}
